pages.label: Session 1
pages.title: SESSION 1: THE SHEPHERD
pages.subtitle: Psalm 23:1-3. Read the whole psalm before you begin.

content.text: Read Psalm 23 twice in the NASB 2020, once silently and once aloud. Then copy verses 1 to 3 here in your own hand, slowly enough to notice each word.

content.prompt: What does the text say? Note every picture of what the shepherd does and what the sheep receive.
What would these pictures have meant to David, a shepherd himself? What do they show about who God is?

left.prompt: Where do I need to be led this week?
